notes: POC found Hosted API is easy to integrate but cost variance at scale is a concern
Product team wants predictable monthly unit economics — moving toward Dedicated
Target latency: <=150ms p95 for chat (50 token responses), throughput target: 30-50 reqs/sec sustained
Cost sensitivity: mid (willing to commit if pricing predictable and burst available)
Preferred model family: Llama-like open models (70B quantized) or Mistral; willing to accept smaller model fallback for tail queries
Want automated routing: domestic hosted -> dedicated fallback -> smaller model for cost savings
Security: must have SOC2 + SSO, KMS for keys, audit logging, and EU data residency for EU customers
Quote from CTO: 'We need unit economics we can plan by product line — surprises kill adoption.'
Sales note: CFO wants a clear ramp schedule tied to commit levels, with predictable overage caps
poc_plan: Week 1 - Integration + smoke tests on Dedicated eval cluster
Week 2 - Workload replay using production traces; measure p95 and throughput
Week 3 - Batching and KV cache tuning; run cost-per-token estimations
Week 4 - Security pen-test & VPC peering proof-of-concept
Week 5 - Scale soak test with synthetic traffic; validate autoscaling/burst behavior
Week 6 - Exec demo + handoff to procurement/legal
pricing_summary: Customer prefers a 12-month committed contract with monthly invoicing
Initial proposal: commit = 50M tokens/month baseline (equivalent to expected steady-state), 12-month term
Burst buffer: additional 2x baseline capacity available at 50% surcharge (apply to short spikes up to 72 hours)
Overage: billed at 1.5x committed unit price; client asked for soft cap notification at 85% of commit
Ramp schedule requested: 3-month linear ramp to baseline (month1=40%, month2=70%, month3=100%), credits for missed SLOs
Alternate quote: reserved throughput model (GPU-hour commit) — Redwood to provide conversion estimate and example cost scenarios
Requested add-ons: extended retention for observability + higher retention of token-level billing data (pricing impact TBD)
decision_criteria: Predictable monthly cost and clear overage policy
Satisfy security/compliance checklist (SSO, KMS, SOC2, audit logs, EU residency)
Latency SLOs (p95 <= 150ms) on Dedicated for primary chat flows
Operational controls: canary rollouts, fallback routing, and burst capacity guarantees
Commercial: 12-month term with defined ramp schedule and clear exit/transition terms
